record.title: Bounded cyclic-exchange conjecture for basis sequences
record.statement: Let $(B_1,\dots,B_k)$ and $(B'_1,\dots,B'_k)$ be compatible sequences of $k$ bases of a rank-$r$ matroid. A **cyclic exchange** is the simultaneous cyclic transfer of elements among distinct basis positions, with every resulting set required to be a basis. **Bounded cyclic-exchange conjecture.** The sequence $(B_1,\dots,B_k)$ can be transformed into $(B'_1,\dots,B'_k)$ by using at most $r$ cyclic exchanges. This is proposed as a generalization of Hamidoune's conjecture and is presented as open in the source.
record.source_name: Kristóf Bérczi, Áron Jánosik and Bence Mátravölgyi, “Cyclic ordering of split matroids”, arXiv:2411.01061 (2024).
record.references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.01061

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of November 2024). “The conjecture was settled for graphic matroids , sparse paving matroids , matroids of rank at most $4$ and $5$ , split matroids , and regul”
